map.alt: A bright cel-shaded 3d riverside village map with branching paths and a wooden bridge.

character.alt: A full-body cel-shaded 3d adult field cartographer with practical exploration gear.

specification.characterDirection: Build clearly adult characters with natural anatomy, practical layered equipment, grounded poses, and silhouettes that remain distinct at thumbnail size.
specification.environmentDirection: Compose maps around immediately legible traversal hierarchy, routes that continue beyond the frame, useful landmarks, and generous walkable space.
specification.propDirection: Give every prop a clear gameplay purpose, readable material grouping, and a silhouette that survives at gameplay scale without decorative clutter.
specification.effectsDirection: Keep effects compact, high contrast, and brief so they communicate timing without obscuring characters, landmarks, or traversal.
specification.uiHudDirection: Use compact panels, high-contrast icons, plain readable labels, and restrained ornament; interface meaning must never depend on the preview images.
specification.accessibility: Maintain value separation between walkable terrain, obstacles, characters, and interaction targets; never rely on hue alone, and avoid flicker or visually noisy backgrounds.
specification.visualIdentity: Polished stylized 3D forms presented through graphic light bands, selective ink accents, clean silhouettes, and energetic color separation.
specification.pixelTechnique: Use smooth modeled surfaces, two-step cel lighting, hard shadow boundaries, selective contour accents, and simplified non-photoreal materials.
specification.shapeLanguage: Favor smooth tapered volumes, readable bevels, sweeping curves, and decisive silhouette breaks while avoiding visible polygon faceting.
specification.paletteAndLighting: Use saturated green, bright blue, warm wood, orange-red accents, and cool gray with a hard two-band key light and restrained rim light.
specification.animationDirection: Animate with strong 3D key poses, readable arcs, short graphic holds, stable outlines, and deliberate transitions between light bands.
